# Selection for improved flight performance

## Egg-to-adult survivorship assay

See Methods section for details of experimental set-up.

### Call relevant packages

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(lmerTest)

theme_set(theme_cowplot())
```

### Import and wrangle data

Imported into a tibble "Surv_data_raw" and processed into "Surv_data" which contains proportion survivorship per vial. The initial egg count for each vial was 70.

```{r}
Surv_data_raw <- read_excel("~/Flying_Flies_Phenotyping/Raw_data/FF_Survivorship.xlsx")

Egg_count = 70 #See methods

Surv_data <- Surv_data_raw %>% group_by(Selection, Replicate, Vial) %>% summarize(Total_flies = sum(Count)) %>% mutate(Surv = Total_flies/Egg_count)

Surv_data <- Surv_data %>% mutate(PopRep = paste(Selection, Replicate, sep="_")) %>% 
  mutate(VialNum = paste(PopRep, Vial, sep = "_V")) %>% 
  mutate_at(c("Selection", "PopRep", "VialNum"), factor)

# Remove anomalous points (greater than 70 Egg collection, or very early F2 eclosion). Drop NA values.

Surv_data <- Surv_data %>% filter(Surv < 1) %>% drop_na()
```

#### Analysis

On arc sine square root transformed survivorship.

```{r}
Surv_data <- Surv_data %>% mutate(asqrt_Surv = asin(sqrt(Surv)))

fit_surv1 <- lmer(asqrt_Surv ~ Selection + (1|PopRep), data = Surv_data)
#fit_surv2 <- lmer(Surv ~ Selection + (1|PopRep) + (1|VialNum), data = Surv_data) #this leads to an error due to no replication for nested vial IDs. 

anova(fit_surv1)
eta_squared(fit_surv1)
```

### Plots

```{r}
surv_plot <- ggplot(data = Surv_data, 
                    aes(x = Selection, y = Surv)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + 
  geom_point(aes(shape = factor(Replicate)), 
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), 
             size = 3, color = "darkgrey", alpha = 0.5) + 
  stat_summary(fun = "mean", color = "red", shape = "-", size = 4) +
  labs(x = "Selection", y = "Egg-to-adult Survivorship", shape = "Replicate")

print(surv_plot)
```
